edges: Howard Gardner introduced the concept of multiple intelligences.
Howard Gardner identified linguistic intelligence as one of the types of intelligence.
Howard Gardner identified logical-mathematical intelligence as one of the types of intelligence.
Howard Gardner identified spatial intelligence as one of the types of intelligence.

Howard Gardner.label: Person
Howard Gardner.name: Howard Gardner

Multiple Intelligences.label: Field
Multiple Intelligences.name: Multiple Intelligences
Multiple Intelligences.description: Identified seven different types of intelligence.

Linguistic Intelligence.label: Intelligence Type
Linguistic Intelligence.name: Linguistic Intelligence
Linguistic Intelligence.description: Relates to an individual's ability to process and communicate written and spoken words.

Logical-Mathematical Intelligence.label: Intelligence Type
Logical-Mathematical Intelligence.name: Logical-Mathematical Intelligence
Logical-Mathematical Intelligence.description: Relates to a person's ability to reason logically, think scientifically, and perform well in mathematical calculations.

Spatial Intelligence.label: Intelligence Type
Spatial Intelligence.name: Spatial Intelligence
Spatial Intelligence.description: Relates to vision and spatial judgment.

Bodily-Kinesthetic Intelligence.label: Intelligence Type
Bodily-Kinesthetic Intelligence.name: Bodily-Kinesthetic Intelligence
Bodily-Kinesthetic Intelligence.description: Relates to the ability to learn best by physically practicing an action.

Musical Intelligence.label: Intelligence Type
Musical Intelligence.name: Musical Intelligence
Musical Intelligence.description: Relates to the ability in defining differences in rhythms and tones.

Interpersonal Intelligence.label: Intelligence Type
Interpersonal Intelligence.name: Interpersonal Intelligence
Interpersonal Intelligence.description: Relates to an individual's ability to communicate and empathize with others.

Intrapersonal Intelligence.label: Intelligence Type
Intrapersonal Intelligence.name: Intrapersonal Intelligence
Intrapersonal Intelligence.description: Relates to an individual's ability to understand themselves.
